description: List databases visible to the configured role in the Snowflake account.
embedding_description: List the Snowflake databases the operator's read-only warehouse role can see. The starting point for exploring the data warehouse: begin here, then drill into a database's schemas and their tables before writing a query against it.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with databases: a list of {name} objects.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: List the database names plainly; low sensitivity (metadata only, data_sensitivity 0.1).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List databases visible to the configured Snowflake role.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: snowflake.auth_failed: the key-pair JWT was rejected. snowflake.permission_denied: the role has no visible databases. snowflake.api_error: an unexpected warehouse error.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: snowflake.auth_failed/permission_denied: ask the operator to check the connecting user's key and role grants.
